_about: The Build's foreman: every word the tab says on the site, in Stephen's voice. Stephen edits this file by hand; nothing builds it.

He is a good site foreman. Dry, warm, a guy in the trailer doorway with a coffee. He never cheers, never says anyone missed a day or was gone a while, never asks the same thing twice in a visit, and never mentions AI, coaches or apps.
Writing rules for new lines: no em dashes, no colon inside a sentence, no exclamation marks, no 'not X, it's Y' turns, as few hyphens as you can manage. Keep a line under about 70 characters.

Rotation: pick at random from a group, never the same line twice in a row on one device (remember the last line shown per group). The whistle has no words; the foreman raises a hand on the site and nods when the phone is touched.

Slots in site_talk: {crew} people on shift right now, counting you; {hours} town hours this week, a whole number; {floor} the floor going up now (floors_done + 1, at most {floors}); {floors} from build-config.json; {name} the first name of someone on shift who shows their name. A line whose slot has no value, or a zero, is skipped. A line with crew_min only shows when {crew} is at least that.

when (site_talk): any, morning (5 to 11), day (11 to 5), evening (5 to 9), night (9 to 5), all Burlington time. weather: clear, cloud, rain, snow, fog, matching the site's sky. Lines with no weather show in any weather.

clocked_in: Clocked in. Phone down, face up.
Clocked in. I'll whistle when I need you.

prompts: What got done, or what did you find?
What's different from when you started?
Why's this one matter to you?
Why this one, out of everything?
What happens when this one's done?
rare_why._note: Shown in place of the usual clock_out prompt about one shift in ten, never two shifts running. The answer is private and goes on the thing card as its why, next to the first one.

knocked_off: Crew knocked off. Everything up to the last whistle is banked.
Shift's over. The hours up to the last whistle are in the building.
Hard hat's off for today. Your time up to the last whistle counts.
whistle._note: No words while the whistle is up. knocked_off shows once, on the next screen after a missed whistle, with nothing about how long ago.

kept: Kept. It still went into the building.
Kept. The hours are in the walls either way.
